instruction: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, find instructions for downloading a bank statement and save the webpage as a PDF named bank_statement_instructions.pdf on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, search for instructions on downloading a bank statement.
Open a relevant bank help page or support article.
Review the instructions for downloading a bank statement.
Choose 'Save as PDF' as the destination.
Save the webpage as bank_statement_instructions.pdf on the Desktop.
Leave the PDF file on the Desktop.
